info.title: virtspawn API
info.description: REST API for managing libvirt virtual machines, networks, storage, and more.

GuacamoleAuthResponse.description: Encrypted JSON blob for Apache Guacamole /api/tokens (requires [guacamole] in daemon config)

guac_data.description: POST as form field data to Guacamole /api/tokens

token.description: Optional Guacamole auth token when fetch_token succeeds

cloud_init_iso.description: Optional second CD-ROM (cloud-init seed); install ISO uses `iso`

create_backend.description: Omit or empty for server default; libvirt_xml or virt_install to override.

virt_builder_os.description: Legacy libguestfs virt-builder template (virt-builder --list). Disabled by default on the server ([libvirt] virt_builder_allowed). Prefer mkosi_workspace for new deployments.

virt_builder_hostname.description: Guest hostname for virt-builder (optional; derived from VM name if empty).

virt_builder_ssh_pubkey.description: Single-line OpenSSH public key for root SSH inject (optional if root password file or server default pubkey path is set).

virt_builder_root_password_file.description: Absolute path on the daemon host to a small file (≤4KiB) with guest root password; virt-builder uses --root-password file:… (not password: on argv).

mkosi_workspace.description: Preferred: absolute path to directory containing mkosi.conf; run `mkosi build` and use newest .raw/.qcow2 artifact as root disk. Mutually exclusive with virt_builder_os.

mkosi_image.description: For multi-image mkosi workspaces (image trees): select a specific image via `mkosi --image <name>`. Leave empty to build the workspace normally.

post.summary: Create VM with live SSE logs (mkosi / virt-builder / virt-install / qemu-img)
post.description: Long-running HTTP response. Put reverse proxies in front with a generous read/send timeout (e.g. hours) or mkosi builds may be cut off.

200.description: text/event-stream; default events are log lines, then `event: complete` with JSON or `event: error`

get.summary: KubeVirt migration bundle (CDI upload DV + VM YAML, virtio root + virtio-win CDROM)
get.description: Derives the root disk from libvirt domain XML, emits a CDI DataVolume (upload) and kubevirt.io VirtualMachine with virtio disks. virtio-win is attached as containerDisk (cluster image; configure [kubevirt] virtio_container_disk_image). Query: namespace, k8s_vm_name, datavolume_name, storage_gi, storage_class, include_virtio_cdrom (default true).
Returns VNC target + signed/encrypted `guac_data` for Apache Guacamole JSON auth. Disabled unless [guacamole] enabled=true and json_secret_hex set.
